operation.description:
Request a device and user code

Follow [rfc8628#section-3.2](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8628#section-3.2)

client_id.description: The client ID of the application

user_id.description: The user ID to which the device code should be pre-bound.

verification_uri.description: The URL for user verification. Defaults to /device if not configured.

verification_uri_complete.description: The complete URL with user code as query parameter.

expires_in.description: Lifetime in seconds of the device code

401.description: Unauthorized. Due to missing or invalid authentication.

403.description: Forbidden. You do not have permission to access this resource or to perform this action.

404.description: Not Found. The requested resource was not found.

429.description: Too Many Requests. You have exceeded the rate limit. Try again later.
